comment: No source is published. The normalling of the decimator input to the bitcrusher output, and the sample trigger overriding the internal one, are the maker's own tooltips in the installed build. The panel prints IN, SYNC, SAMPLE and OUT and nothing else: the two sections are marked with icons, and the words STOMP and CHOMP appear only in the manual and the tooltips. The one volt per octave tracking of the decimator's oscillator at the counter-clockwise end of its depth attenuverter is from the T-Wrex hardware manual version 1.0 and could not be checked against the plugin; the maker does carry that fact in a tooltip on Zzzorb's pitch attenuverter but not on this one. The T-Wrex hardware manual version 1.0 was read as a PDF on this pass. It adds the two ways the trigger inputs are meant to be used and confirms the linear dry/wet crossfade, the normalling of the decimator input to the bitcrusher output, the OR of the SYNC input with the bitcrusher's own trigger, and the SAMPLE input overriding the decimator's oscillator. It states no range or threshold for any control.
